steps.content:
Buy from **A - Ottervale Audio**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/raj2r7/a

Not from **B - Brackmoor Sound**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/raj2r7/b

On price, product, and terms they look identical:

* **Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite - same specs on both
* **Price:** $129.00 both
* **Rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) both
* **Shipping:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days both
* **Returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method both
* **Warranty listed:** 1-year limited warranty both

The only difference is trust:

Brackmoor Sound claims on its listing:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

Ottervale Audio makes no such claim.

But Quellwyn's official authorized dealers list:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/raj2r7/dealers

says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

That means:

1. B's authorization claim is false.
2. B's promise of "Full manufacturer warranty" can't be true, since Quellwyn only gives full manufacturer warranty via authorized dealers.

Ottervale is just offering its own 1-year limited warranty without pretending to be authorized.

If you have to pick one of these two, pick the honest one - **Ottervale Audio**.

Ideally, don't pick either if you want the full manufacturer warranty - buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead.
